name: ubhayaab-profile
description: Self-generating GitHub profile README. Every image is built by a script in this repo and committed as a file, so nothing on the page depends on a third-party service staying up.

scripts.assets: node scripts/gen-hero.mjs && node scripts/gen-rhythm.mjs && node scripts/gen-cards.mjs
scripts.build: npm run stats && npm run assets && npm run lint && npm run readme
scripts.offline: npm run assets && npm run lint && npm run readme
